title: Budget 2027: Sovereign AI Cloud Planned, 100,000 More Free AI Subscriptions, AI App To Check Scams
key_facts: Prime Minister and Finance Minister Anwar Ibrahim announced on Friday 9 Oct 2026, presenting Budget 2027 in the Dewan Rakyat, that Malaysia plans a Sovereign AI Cloud to keep citizens' data and strategic information under Malaysian control.
The Budget adds 100,000 free AI subscriptions for young people, widening the scheme to AI applications such as ChatGPT.
The National Scam Response Centre will develop an AI application to check phone numbers, bank accounts or suspicious links before a transaction.
Individual tax relief under the lifestyle category will cover AI subscriptions.
RM6 billion is allocated across ministries for research, development and commercialisation; AI Malaysia Berhad gets nearly RM15 million, targeting 200,000 AI-skilled workers.
A RM30 million MDEC fund will help 4,000 SMEs adopt AI.
An E-Commerce Bill will be tabled at the next Parliament meeting.
quote_evidence: The government is planning a Sovereign AI Cloud to keep citizens' data and the country's strategic information under Malaysian control, Prime Minister and Finance Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim announced on Friday (9 October).
Anwar said Malaysia should pioneer AI without risking the nation's values and security.
why_it_matters_hint: Malaysia is putting budget money behind keeping data and AI capability at home.
notes: No cost, date or provider for the Sovereign AI Cloud is given in the article.
